conjunction linking this instruction to the prior context
ritual seat or support in worship
prescriptive cognition of the ritual arrangement
epithet of the goddess Tripureśī as the agent or basis

items.question: What six-limbed seat is to be recognized through the goddess Tripureśī?
premises: The instruction directs one to know the seat through this goddess.
The goddess specified as the basis is Tripureśī.
The seat is characterized as six-limbed.
items.inference: Therefore, through Tripureśī one should recognize the ritual seat as constituted in six limbs.
uncertainties: The specific six limbs constituting the seat are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And by this Tripureśī one should know the seat to be six-limbed.
